_scenario: Five-account household (~$100k total net worth) that has drifted after a two-year equity rally.
Sized to feel familiar to a typical early-career or mid-career saver while still exercising every engine feature.
Accounts
schwab-taxable  Schwab Joint Taxable        TAXABLE           $25k
fidelity-ira    Fidelity Trad IRA            TRADITIONAL_IRA   $27k positions + $1.5k newCash
empower-401k    Empower 401k                 FOUR_OH_ONE_K     $36.5k (no ALTERNATIVES allowed)
fidelity-roth   Fidelity Roth IRA            ROTH_IRA          $8k    (concentrates ALTERNATIVES; acceptsDeposits: false — Roth maxed for the year)
fidelity-hsa    Fidelity HSA                 HSA               $1.5k
